<script>
  window.onload = function() {
    const navbar = document.querySelector('.navbar > .container-fluid');
    const pageTitle = document.createElement('span');
    
    // 1. ADD THIS LINE: Give the element an ID
    pageTitle.id = 'dynamic-page-title'; 
    
    pageTitle.innerHTML = "Coding Tutorials";
    
    pageTitle.style.color = 'white';
    pageTitle.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
    pageTitle.style.fontSize = '3rem';
    pageTitle.style.position = 'absolute';
    pageTitle.style.left = '300px';
    pageTitle.style.transform = 'translateX(0%)';
    pageTitle.style.zIndex = '9999';
    pageTitle.style.textShadow = '3px 3px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)';
    
    if (navbar) {
        navbar.appendChild(pageTitle);
    }
  };
</script>
